chunks: Ahmad ibn Mihrān, from Muḥammad ibn ʿAlī, from Muʿammar ibn Khallād, who said:

We mentioned something in the presence of Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام after Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام had been born to him, so he said: “What need do you have for that? This is Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام. I have seated him in my seat and placed him in my position.”

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, identified here as the one placed in the Imam's position
key_terms.أَبِي الْحَسَنِ: Abū al-Ḥasan, the Imam in whose presence the statement was made
key_terms.ذَكَرْنَا: we mentioned; introducing the companions' discussion in the Imam's presence
key_terms.مَجْلِسِي: my seat; a marker of authority and formal position
key_terms.مَكَانِي: my place; indicating succession to the Imam's station

ai.seo_question: How does al-Kāfī report the designation of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام by Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith records Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام explicitly directing attention to Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام after his birth and declaring that he had seated him in his own seat and position. In context, it serves as an indication of the Imam's designation of Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام and his future religious authority.
